record.body:
## Description

R1: Known task (and peer) references navigate to the matching overlay or milestone focus.
R7: Labels prefer title/type over raw id when known.
R8: Unresolved references stay plain text.

Covers phase exit criteria: navigation, labels/unresolved, and the automated test gate. Manual follow-the-link is a separate acceptance.

## Approach

Re-run the focused unit and UI test files for deep-links through the real vitest entry points. Confirm unresolved tokens stay plain and labels prefer titles. Manual: open a detail that cites another id and follow the link.
record.subject: verify-deep-links
